description: Pulse Wave 6.1.17 — Playlist Playback Splicing Fix, Widget RemoteViews Compliance, Library Top Playlist Placement & Speed Dial Home Fix.

changelog.title: Playlist Playback & Queue Loading Fix
items: Atomic Queue Timeline Loading: Playlist items load atomically into ExoPlayer rather than splicing chunks, preventing playback interruptions and queue drops.
Async State Guard: Fixed premature STATE_IDLE termination in MusicService to guarantee coroutine playlist loading completes.
Radio Guard: Protected active playlists from being wiped out by automatic recommendation radio transitions.
Clean Start Bounds: Sanitized playlist start offsets to eliminate playback failure caused by previous playlist offsets.

changelog.title: Widget RemoteViews Compliance & Stability
items: RemoteViews Inflation Fix: Replaced illegal non-RemoteViews tags (<View> and <Space>) with valid <ImageView> and weighted <FrameLayout> across turntable, queue, and now-playing widgets.
Binder IPC Overflow Prevention: Added dimension clamping to widget art generation to prevent TransactionTooLargeException buffer crashes.

changelog.title: Playlist Cards Library Top Placement & Speed Dial
items: Top Placement in Library: When custom sorting or tapping 'Move to Top', user playlist cards appear directly at the top of the Library (above auto playlists) in both Grid and List views.
Free Drag to Top: Lifted reordering constraint so playlists can be dragged to the very top (index 0) of the list.
Stable Auto-Playlist IDs: Fixed auto playlist random UUID recreation so custom covers and state persist reliably.
Speed Dial on Home: Re-enabled Speed Dial feed so pinned playlist cards appear right at the top of the Home screen.
